new_insert_email_body.title: Team Sync – can we move it to the 29th?
new_insert_email_body.text:
Hi Emma,

I was thinking about the Paris dinner planning on Tuesday, May 21. The current 10:00 AM Team Sync would clash with the restaurant selection you're coordinating for Pierre. To keep the morning free, could you reschedule the sync to May 29 from 10:00 to 11:00 AM? That way the dinner task can move forward without conflict.

Best,
Mark
